github.description: A watchdog plugin for DeepSeek Harness: on a **quota / rate-limit (HTTP 429)** error, it automatically creates a fixed-interval scheduled task that keeps delivering a "continue the task" prompt until it succeeds or you take over. DeepSeek Harness 的 watchdog 插件：遇到 **配额/限流（HTTP 429）** 时，自动创建一个固定间隔的定时任务，到点持续投递「继续任务」的提示，直到任务成功或你手动接手。
